When you allow it, your agent can ask which song is playing in the Music app. Sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
When you allow it, your agent can read your upcoming events, or add an event you see first. Events are sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.

The camera scans the pairing QR code of your bridge, takes the photos you send in the chat, and during a call it shows your agent what you point it at when you choose Look. Pictures go end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
When you allow it, your agent can look up a contact by name (up to 5 matches). Results are sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
Face ID confirms that you approve a command your assistant wants to run.
When you allow it, your agent can ask whether a Focus is on, so it knows when not to disturb you. Sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.

When you allow it, your agent can read today's steps and active energy, last night's sleep and your resting heart rate. Sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only; nothing is written to Health.
Hermes Call never writes to Health; it only reads what you allow above.
When you allow it, your agent can read which Home accessories are on. Hermes Call never controls them. Sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
Hermes Call connects calls directly to your own bridge when it is on the same network as this iPhone.

Place reminders your agent sets for you ("when I'm at the supermarket") are watched by this iPhone itself, also while the app is closed. Your location is never sent to your agent for this; searching a place by name asks Apple Maps with only an area of about 5 km around you.
When you allow it, your agent can ask where you are (about 1 km unless you allow precise). It is sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
Hermes Call uses the microphone while you are on a call with your assistant and when you record a voice note. Audio is end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge.
When you allow it, your agent can ask whether you are walking or driving and for today's steps. Sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
When you allow it, your agent can read your open reminders, or add a reminder you see first. Reminders are sent end-to-end encrypted to your own bridge only.
